notes.glasses: Eyeglasses allowed only if frames are thin and lenses completely transparent. No heavy frames or jewelry.
notes.smile: Neutral expression with eyes looking straight ahead and lips naturally closed.
notes.ears: Ears and forehead MUST be clearly visible. Hair must not cover eyebrows or ears.
notes.shadows: No shadows anywhere on the face, contours, or backdrop.
notes.babyRules: Infant must be positioned facing camera with both ears and eyes visible, neutral background.
